title: Clinical Decision Tree Schema v1.0
description: Hartzog.ai Clinical Decision Support Tree — content-first, display-agnostic schema for point-of-care decision trees in rural and neonatal/pediatric medicine. Display rendering is handled separately by the D3.js rendering engine (Clinical Decision Tree Standard v3). Informed by CDSS usability best practices (PMID 32570513, 34784293, 38551639).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Always '1.0.0' for first-generation trees.

tree.description: Metadata about this decision tree as a clinical artifact.

id.description: Slug-style unique identifier for this tree. Used in URLs and file names.

title.description: Full display title of the decision tree.
examples: Neonatal Respiratory Distress — Initial Evaluation and Management

specialty.description: Primary clinical specialty this tree is designed for.

description.description: Plain language description of target patient population.

exclusions.description: Patient populations explicitly excluded from this tree.

entry_node_id.description: ID of the first node to render when the tree is launched.

version.description: Semantic version of this tree's clinical content.

guideline_sources.description: Primary clinical guidelines or evidence sources this tree is based on.

last_reviewed.description: ISO date when clinical content was last reviewed by a clinician.

textbook_base_url.description: Base URL for textbook links on this site. Terminal nodes append their relative path.

clinical_disclaimer.description: Required disclaimer text rendered at the bottom of every node.
clinical_disclaimer.default: This clinical decision support tool is intended as a reference aid and does not replace clinical judgment. Always verify against current institutional protocols and guidelines.

glossary.description: Shared definitions pool. Nodes reference entries by key. Keeps definitions DRY across the tree.

abbreviation.description: Common abbreviation if different from term key.

extended_notes.description: Optional deeper explanation for education panel.

reference.description: Evidence_base key for citation of this definition.

RDS.definition: Surfactant-deficiency lung disease of preterm infants causing progressive hypoxemia, decreased lung compliance, and characteristic ground-glass appearance on CXR.

evidence_base.description: Shared reference pool. Nodes cite entries by key. All clinical claims should reference an entry here.

ref_id.description: Matches the object key. Used for internal referencing.

evidence_level.description: Oxford CEBM evidence level or type.

nodes.description: Map of all nodes in the tree, keyed by node ID. Order does not matter; rendering order is determined by entry_node_id and routing logic.

display_config.description: Global display settings. Consumed by the D3.js rendering engine (Clinical Decision Tree Standard v3). Completely separate from clinical content — changing this object does not alter clinical logic.

node_color_map.description: Maps node urgency_level to CSS color. Overrides CDS v3 defaults.

show_evidence_tab.description: Whether to show the evidence tab in education popups.

show_education_panel.description: Whether to show the slide-out education resources panel.

banner.description: Banner configuration for the rendering engine setBannerTheme() API.

Node.description: A single node in the decision tree. Clinical content and display hints are clearly separated.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this tree. Kebab-case. Referenced by routing logic.

type.description: Semantic node type. Drives display color and icon. entry: starting node. decision: branching question. assessment: data gathering. action: immediate intervention. diagnosis: confirmed dx. terminal: endpoint with cheatsheet.

title.description: Short clinician-facing title shown as the node header. Max 80 characters.

education_popup.description: Contextual education shown when the clinician taps the ⓘ icon. Designed to be concise and non-interruptive to reduce alert fatigue.

terminal_content.description: Required when type === 'terminal'. Contains cheatsheet and textbook link.

display_hints.description: Optional display metadata. Does not affect clinical logic. Consumed by D3.js renderer.

ClinicalContent.description: The core clinical data for this node. This is the single source of truth for clinical content — display is handled by display_hints.

summary.description: Concise clinical statement explaining what is happening at this node. Shown prominently to the clinician. Max 200 characters.

diagnostic_criteria.description: Structured criteria that define the clinical condition or trigger at this node.

logic_operator.description: How criteria are combined. ALL = must meet all. ANY = meeting one is sufficient. SCORE = sum scores for routing.

score_thresholds.description: Only used when logic_operator is SCORE. Maps score ranges to labels.

assessment_items.description: Items the clinician should gather or check at this node — labs, vitals, exam findings, history elements.

actions.description: Ordered list of immediate clinical interventions required at this node. Rendered as a numbered action list.

contraindications.description: Contraindications or red flags that should divert clinical decision-making.

time_constraint.description: Optional time-sensitive context for this node.

Criterion.description: A single diagnostic criterion — a specific finding, measurement, or clinical condition.

score_points.description: Point value for SCORE logic_operator systems (e.g., Silverman-Anderson, Downes).

glossary_ref.description: Key into the tree's glossary for inline definition.

evidence_ref.description: Key into the tree's evidence_base for citation.

note.description: Optional clarifying note for the clinician.

AssessmentItem.description: A specific data point the clinician should gather at this node.

timing.description: When to obtain this assessment item.

Action.description: An immediate clinical action or intervention. Actions are ordered — render as numbered list.

dosing.description: Structured dosing information for medication actions.

conditional.description: Human-readable condition under which this action applies. E.g., 'If SpO2 < 85% despite CPAP'.

EducationPopup.description: Point-of-care education shown via the ⓘ icon at this node. Designed per user-centered CDS principles to minimize alert fatigue — concise, tabbed, actionable. Max 5 key points; max 3 definitions to prevent cognitive overload (PMID 32570513).

title.description: Education popup header. Defaults to node title if omitted.

tabs.description: Four standard tabs rendered in the popup. All are optional; omit empty tabs.

definitions.description: Tab 1: Key terms defined at this decision point. Reference glossary keys or define inline.

glossary_ref.description: Key in the tree's glossary object — preferred over inline definition.

term.description: Inline term if not in glossary.

definition.description: Inline definition if not in glossary.

key_points.description: Tab 2: Clinical pearls for this decision point. Max 5 bullets.

evidence.description: Tab 3: Guideline and evidence citations supporting this node's clinical content.

ref_key.description: Key in the tree's evidence_base object.

annotation.description: Brief note explaining relevance of this reference to this specific node.

alerts.description: Tab 4: Critical safety warnings and red flags. High-visibility. Shown with warning icon.

Routing.description: Logic determining which node comes next. Clinical in nature — not a display concern. For terminal nodes, type should be 'end'.

type.description: end: no further nodes. single: always goes to one next node. binary: yes/no question with two branches. conditional: evaluated in order, first true wins. scored: uses diagnostic_criteria score_thresholds. checklist: all items must be addressed before routing.

question.description: For binary and conditional types: the clinical question being answered to determine routing. Shown prominently in the UI.

branches.description: For binary and conditional types: evaluated in order, first condition that evaluates true determines next_node_id.

default_next_node_id.description: Fallback next node if no branch condition matches. Required when type is conditional.

next_node_id.description: Used only with type 'single' — the one and only next node.

checklist_items.description: For checklist type: all items must be checked before the clinician can proceed to next_node_id.

RoutingBranch.description: A single branch in binary or conditional routing. Clinician selects a branch or condition is programmatically evaluated.

label.description: Human-readable branch label shown to clinician. E.g., 'Yes — meets criteria', 'SpO2 < 85%'.

short_label.description: Abbreviated label for edge labels in D3 graph. Max 20 characters.

condition.description: Human-readable condition expression. NOT executable code. Plain clinical language for the renderer and content authors. E.g., 'SpO2 < 85% on room air' or 'Apgar < 7 at 5 min'.

urgency.description: Urgency of the pathway this branch leads to. Informs edge color in renderer.

note.description: Clinical note explaining when to choose this branch.

TerminalContent.description: Present only on terminal nodes. Contains a laminated-card-style cheatsheet and a link to the full textbook on the site. This is the 'end state' clinical reference for the clinician after traversing the tree.

cheatsheet.description: Compact, actionable quick-reference — equivalent to a laminated pocket card.

one_liner.description: One-sentence clinical summary for this terminal state.

immediate_actions.description: Prioritized, ordered list of interventions. Rendered as numbered list. Should match a laminated card.

medications.description: Key medications at this terminal state with dosing table.

monitoring_parameters.description: Ongoing monitoring required at this terminal state.

escalation_trigger.description: When to escalate or re-enter decision tree.

disposition.description: Where the patient should go from here.

clinical_pearls.description: High-value clinical pearls for this terminal state. Shown as ★ bullets.

common_pitfalls.description: Common errors or oversights at this terminal state. Shown with ⚠ icon.

family_communication.description: Guidance on what and how to communicate with family at this terminal state.

textbook_link.description: Link to the full-length education guide or textbook chapter on hartzog.ai. Shown as a '📚 Full Textbook' button on the terminal node.

title.description: Title of the linked textbook document.

path.description: Relative path appended to tree.textbook_base_url. E.g., '/neonatal-RDS'.

section_anchor.description: HTML anchor to scroll to within the page. E.g., '#treatment'.

repo_path.description: Path within the Peds GitHub repo for developers. E.g., 'content/education-guides/09-neonatal-rds.docx'.

DisplayHints.description: Rendering metadata consumed by the D3.js Clinical Decision Tree Standard v3 engine. Purely presentational — has no effect on clinical logic or routing. All clinical decisions must be made from clinical_content and routing fields only.

urgency_level.description: Maps to CDS v3 node colors: emergency=red, urgent=orange, decision=yellow, action=green, assessment=blue, diagnosis=purple.

color_override.description: CSS color string. Overrides urgency_level color map for this node only.

icon.description: Unicode or icon class for this node. E.g., '🫁', '💊', '⚡'.

layout_style.description: Suggested rendering template for the node's clinical_content.

expand_by_default.description: Whether this node is expanded in the tree view by default.

highlight.description: Draw attention to this node — e.g., for newly added or recently changed clinical content.

position_hint.description: Optional manual override for node position in the D3 layout. Use sparingly.
